object.name: moxsession_core_manager
object.description: Core manager object for session registration.

c2s.name: create_session
c2s.description: Registers a new session. The daemon responds with a session_created event carrying the assigned session_id. Called by the PAM module at session open time.

s2c.name: session_created

description.summary: session ID assigned to the new session

s2c.description: Sent by the daemon in response to create_session with the unique session identifier the PAM module must pass back in destroy_session.

c2s.name: destroy_session
c2s.description: Deregisters the session identified by session_id. Called by the PAM module at session close time.
